params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination to retrieve the next set of chats.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of chats to return. Upper limit is 100.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone specifier. If missing, UTC is used.

params.name: isScheduled
params.description: When true, only return chats generated by scheduled prompts; when false, only non-scheduled chats.

params.name: globalPromptId
params.description: Filter to chats generated by scheduled prompts that match the given globalPromptId (see curated prompts).

items.docs: Returns a list of chats (ask-ai conversations) for the authenticated user. Pagination is supported.

info.name: Returns a single chat by ID.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the chat to retrieve.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone specifier. If missing, UTC is used.

items.docs: Returns a specific chat (ask-ai conversation) by its unique identifier. Users can only access their own chats or public chats.

info.name: Deletes a single chat by ID.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the chat to delete.

items.docs: Permanently deletes a specific chat (ask-ai conversation) by its unique identifier. Users can only delete their own chats.
